notes.title: Patch Notes : Early Access 4.5_0906#1800
notes.notes:
Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where the area-of-effect detection for phantom-summoning skills was incorrect.
Bug Fix: Fixed an issue with the “Oriental Strongman”  flow charge mechanic.
Gameplay Adjustment: Reduced the Oriental Musician’s skill that gives the player Injury cards from 2 cards to 1, and lowered the frequency of that skill’s use.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Early Access 4.5_0904#1430
notes.notes:
Content Adjustment: Added more descriptive wording to the Super Armor explanation (the Super Armor system will be revised and simplified in future versions).
Content Adjustment: Adjusted Training Grounds NPC behavior to make training easier to complete.
Content Adjustment: Added a card affix/keyword for the Knock-Up effect.
Content Adjustment: When the same card has both draw and discard effects, it will now draw first and then discard (previously it discarded first, then drew).
Content Adjustment: In Reaction Moments, Block Follow-ups from cards in hand can now trigger.
Bug Fix: Fixed a queue evaluation issue caused by homing/tracking attacks.
Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where some combat skills of the Oriental Musician were predicted as blockable but were actually unblockable; prediction corrected.
Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where “Cut” did not correctly apply Bleed.
Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where, after an enemy queue was interrupted, subsequent predictions were incorrect.
Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where, during the fight with Phase-2 Black Shield, starting a sub-turn would cause the Black Shield animation to play repeatedly.
Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where the completion of the Training Grounds combat segment was not recorded.
Bug Fix: Corrected the effect of the “Mortal Combat” card.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Early Access 4.5_0812#1715
notes.notes:
Bug Fix: Event that jumped directly to the BOSS battle
Bug Fix: Master occasionally not taking action
Bug Fix: Fisherman occasionally not taking action
Bug Fix: Predictive display for queue interruption cases (the previous version had an incorrect prompt label, but it functioned correctly)
Content Adjustment: Giants will close in less often and will attack directly when within an appropriate distance

notes.title: Patch Note: EAV4.0_0702#1651
notes.notes:
●BUGFIX: Some cards that require players to select a card to duplicate would get stuck in the selection phase if the player had no cards.
●BUGFIX: Some cards lost their tags after being upgraded.
●BUGFIX: Some non-combat cards displayed combat elements.
●BUGFIX: Errors in explanatory text for some tooltips.
●BUGFIX: Errors or missing effects after upgrading certain equipment.
●BUGFIX: Tribal Warrior ultimate damage and animation mismatch.
●BUGFIX: Grave Lantern Greatsword effect did not match its description.
●BUGFIX: In some cases, actual damage values did not match predicted values. This issue occurred rarely and could not be consistently reproduced.
●BUGFIX: Some cards in certain combat decks did not benefit from glove bonuses (kicking attacks still do not get glove bonuses, which is working as intended).
●BUGFIX: The stats of the Executioner’s equipment were not correctly displayed in the UI.
●Optimization: Disabled replaying preparation phase actions in the replay system (the replay system will no longer show skill card actions).
●Optimization: Performance improvements for the unlocked historical statistics interface.

notes.title: Important Update: EAV4.0_0628#1335
notes.notes: BUGFIX: Fixed a localization issue where some text inside square brackets [] was not being translated.

notes.title: Patch Version: EAV3.4_0523#1921
notes.notes:
BUG Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the engraving [Finishing Move Combo] did not take effect.
Fixed an issue where cards like Shield Bash, when placed in the queue with duplicates and followed by playing another skill card, would clear their duplicate count (and other related bugs, such as gaining block after Shield Bash).
Fixed an issue where using "Combat Inspiration" would soft-lock the game if there were no valid cards in hand to select.
Fixed an issue where "The Pursuer" did not return to the player's hand after being played.

notes.title: Patch Version: EAV3.4_0522#1837
notes.notes:
BUG Fixes

Sub-rounds continue the state of the previous round and do not count as a new round. Therefore, enemy block from the previous round will persist, but Iron Headgear takes effect in the sub-round.
Ham attacks now cause stun (Tribal Warrior).
The Musician uses only melee attacks in certain situations.
Advanced 3 and Advanced 6 Oriental Musician no longer have ultimate skills; the ultimate skill is unusable, and they only play the flute for AoE damage without using melee attacks.
Stagger cards are not critically hit when block is active.
Fixed sound effect issues with certain buttons in the game manual.
Fixed an issue where the cross ability of the Photonic Stance switch would not trigger in some situations.
Abnormal distance judgment when player skill cards counter enemy basic attack cards (e.g., Death Grip).
UI Optimization

Reduced the brightness of temporary card labels.
Text Optimization

Outdated description of Greatsword Duel Stance (current Duel Stance does not change defense cards into attack cards but instead enters a reaction moment after a successful duel).
Incorrect description of Assassin's Breastplate.
English text optimization in character selection and tutorial sections (removed some erroneous "1"s).

notes.title: Patch Version: EAV3.4_0521#1959
notes.notes:
Bug Fix: Champion battle phase transition error
Bug Fix: Abnormal behavior after Black Shield's phase transition is interrupted
Bug Fix: Time-stop-related bug (e.g., activating reaction moment during time stop)
Bug Fix: Turnaround error after a successful dodge (mainly occurring on Sparta)
Bug Fix: Unexpected interruption of Tribal Warrior's ultimate queue
Bug Fix: Card reduction after a successful dodge in certain situations
Bug Fix: True smoke bomb effect error

notes.title: Patch Notes EAv3.4(EAV3.4_0519#2057#f1)
notes.notes:
3.4V Overview
This is the stabilized version of EAV3.0, fixing some bugs and performance issues caused by the overhaul of the 3.0 queue system.

3.4V Bug Fixes

Stun tag bug adjustment
Comprehensive tag adjustments
Card description display bug (abnormal text and punctuation)
Prejudgment optimization for body crossing situations (causing errors like both sides missing attacks but with damage determination in some cases)
Prejudgment optimization for switching positions (causing errors like both sides missing attacks but with damage determination in some cases)
Invalid card category filtering in the backpack
Bleeding effect from darts stacking layers with subsequent damage
Human trafficker's left front kick bug
Abnormal shield charge performance
Compatibility issues with card types from older versions (e.g., certain operations on [Normal Attack Cards])
Champion's "Thrown Weapon" and some attack cards in the third phase missing attacks
Abnormal prejudgment for getting up after breaking queues
Inactive pursuit cards in special situations
Invalid shield and sword pursuit counts
Phase transitions of bosses being interrupted and unable to transition again
Missing translation text in the novice guide descriptions
NPC enemy [Adoptive] queue freezing when mimicking shield and sword combos
Abnormal repeated occurrences of [Pursuit] tag in pre-action
Incorrect description of the [Draw Sword] tag, originally described as "the first card in the queue" but actually "the first card in the turn"
Gamepad functionality restored
3.4V New Features

Added tag scrollbar functionality. Now, overly long explanations can be viewed by scrolling the mouse wheel.
3.4V Optimizations

Improved hit sound effects (e.g., hammers)
Fixed text prompts for reaction moments being blocked in prison scenes
3.4V Content Adjustments

Adjusted the price and strength of certain Holy Nails

notes.title: Version Update: EA_V1.5#11_04_1921f2 (Important)
notes.notes:
Announcement: The numerous issues in the initial release of version 1.5 were due to incomplete testing before launch. All known issues have now been fixed, and we will conduct more comprehensive testing before future releases.
Announcement: Before important future updates, we will attempt to release test versions. Additionally, this month the development team will add a new tester to continuously test the game.
Announcement: Regarding game balance adjustments, we cannot achieve perfection in one go and will make gradual adjustments with each version update. Besides adjusting values and card availability, there will be more structural changes after deploying the new AI.
Announcement: The character "Oriental Strongman" has been significantly strengthened compared to version 1.5's initial release. He remains a character with a unique playstyle.

Version Update Summary:

Bug fixes
Deployment of cloud save feature
Redesign of some beginner guide cards
Game experience optimization
Text corrections (including in-game text and Steam achievement text)
Version Details

[Important] New Feature: STEAM Cloud Save Deployment
[Important] Content Adjustment: [Perfect Golden Spiral] will no longer follow the player into the next game (originally set to be removed only when the player's character dies).
Bug Fix: The [Chase] card that was changed to flexible pursuit did not take effect.

Bug Fix: The Berserker Helmet [Bloodthirsty] sometimes does not convert to [Overcome] Card.

Content adjustment: The weapon [Grave Lantern Greatsword] shows no change in text after upgrading in some languages.

When a player attempts to lock a Preservation Card, prompt "You cannot select this card; it does not meet the conditions."
